title: Pre-Registration: EFC dN/dM (z>7) Halo Mass Function via µ(a) Perturbation Channel
abstract: Sealed pre-registration of an Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) prediction for the high-redshift (z=7–12) halo mass function n(M,z) derived via the µ(a) perturbation channel and a gated background. The work locks the structural chain g(a) → µ(a) → D(a) → σ(M,z) → n(M,z), specifies datasets (JWST CEERS/COSMOS-Web/GLASS), HMF prescriptions (Press–Schechter, Sheth–Tormen, Tinker 2008/2010), and explicit falsification thresholds, to be executed once (B, zt, n) are fixed by a joint S(z) fit.
